adjudication.construction: SELECTED_CONDITIONAL: one-journal + one-certificate attempt only if full physical proof against Q2 survives; otherwise keep second certificate and take one-journal + recovery + prepared session. Recovery repair selected independently.
adjudication.durable_index: NOT_SELECTED_NOW; conditional second-stage option behind REQ-COST-LAYER-DECOMPOSITION and REQ-DERIVED-INDEX-BINDING. Prepared-session-first is the smaller first change; the 1.30GB index retained cost (4.19x estate) and invalidation economics must be earned by measurement.
adjudication.prepared_session: SELECTED_FIRST_QUERY_STEP; forward-wire existing PreparedI03Session to the actual first consumer and saved Batch units, keep check_current and per-operation fact/replay. Sourcefree tests only; not protected/native qualification.

new_requirements.architectural_consequence: Durable index is a conditional second-stage option, not selected by the first handoff.
new_requirements.negative_probe: A producer-self-hashed index is accepted as source truth, or a stale index serves after revocation; must refuse.
new_requirements.owner: S2-C/D physical owner + S05/Long Memory + S04/I03 scientific owner
new_requirements.positive_probe: Index open after H uses only locators; changed manifest/I02/source/current/revocation refuses; rebuild from canonical reproduces exact facts; retained-size gate reported.
new_requirements.substantive_requirement: Any durable derived locator/selection index must store no canonical bodies or evidence, bind to the exact manifest SHA, I02 roots, release/replay/universe, family censuses, row-group topology and schema, be independently validated on open after cold validation, refuse on any source/root/currentness/authority/wave change, and have an owner plus rebuild/restore/revocation procedure. It must pass a retained-size and 6 GiB gate before adoption.
new_requirements.why_needed: A persisted index is the only route that removes S from a one-operation fresh open, but the cited SQLite index is 1.30 GB (4.19x the 310.16 MB estate) and could become a stale second authority.

new_requirements.architectural_consequence: Evidence output is a first-class cost layer; no blanket no-cache/full-rehash law is adopted, only exact-identity sharing and replay.
new_requirements.negative_probe: Sharing a reverse F2 denominator with forward F2, or serving a cached fact after revocation; must refuse.
new_requirements.owner: S05/Long Memory + S04/I03 scientific owner + F1-F4 science owner
new_requirements.positive_probe: Identical exact set identity shares one content-addressed set ref; changed direction/weight/wave/missing creates a separate set; replay re-executes and matches fact refs.
source_grounding: QUERY/NEW_FRAME_REQUIREMENTS.json FRAME-Q3; QUERY/COST_MODEL.json corrected numeric note
new_requirements.substantive_requirement: Facts, risk/denominator member refs, provenance, authorities, replay and negatives remain exact and reconstructible. Content-addressed exact risk/denominator set objects may be referenced across operations only when the exact population, condition, routing, measure regime and wave identity are identical; forward/reverse F2, weighted/unweighted, missing/routing and cross-wave sets remain separate. Replay of an identical operation re-executes and compares exact fact refs; a cached fact is never authoritative.
new_requirements.why_needed: Facts currently carry full risk_set_member_refs and denominator_member_refs; at 100k, 2*100000 refs at 150-250 bytes is 30-50 MB per fact before provenance, so 100 facts is 3-5 GB. Actual cardinality/serialization is unmeasured.

new_requirements.architectural_consequence: Construct in a private stage; publish with a proven no-clobber claim/lease; typed orphan; GC only proven-dead scratch. Preserve manifest/member hashes.
new_requirements.negative_probe: A manifest-less target is accepted, silently overwritten, or deleted while another writer may be active; must refuse.
new_requirements.owner: Shared-frame architect + independent C + S2-C/D physical writer owner
new_requirements.positive_probe: Kill at each publish step; no cold reader accepts incomplete estate; restart completes or removes only typed orphan; completed release remains byte-identical and readable.
new_requirements.substantive_requirement: Construction and publication must be crash-consistent and recoverable: no partially built estate may be readable as valid; a completed release must never be deleted or overwritten by a failed or concurrent build; an interrupted build leaves only typed scratch/orphan state identifiable, discardable or resumable under an explicit lease without touching a completed or another writer release; manifest/member fsync and no-clobber are explicit. Do not assume a portable atomic rename silently gives no-clobber; where rename may replace, use a no-clobber claim/lease or a typed ORPHAN_REQUIRES_OPERATOR.
new_requirements.why_needed: Actual code creates the content-addressed target before manifest.json; a crash in that window leaves a manifest-less target that later builds refuse. User mission requires bounded reliable construction and interrupted recovery.

numeric_corrections.evidence_refs: 2*100000 ExactRefs at 150-250 bytes = 30,000,000-50,000,000 bytes (30-50 MB) per fact, not 15-25 MB; 100 facts = 3-5 GB before provenance. Actual cardinality/serialization unmeasured.
numeric_corrections.four_op_factor: The 1.69-1.70x four-operation figure is an author report, not a measured 100-op asymptote. Any S/Q inference is hypothetical and must be labeled.

why_versioned: Both specialist returns identified material whole-system gaps not explicit in the base 16: H/S/Q/O cost separation, derived-index binding/invalidation, exact evidence-output/replay identity, and interrupted-construction recovery. The base frame and its 16/118 rows are preserved unchanged; this addendum is the shared v2 common frame for final selection.
